messages:
alex: FYI PR #49801 is up — runtime changes to continuous batching and a small routing policy tweak. Need runtime + platform + security signoff for canary. pinging @maya @chris @sam. can we get async eyes? :pray:
maya: taking a look. can you paste the CLI diff or point to the files to focus on?
alex: sure — main changes:
```diff
diff --git a/orch/routing/policies.go b/orch/routing/policies.go
+ func prefer_low_cost(req Request) Policy { /* picks cheaper model variant */ }
- // previous fallback logic simplified
```
Also added a flag `--enable-prefetch-ttl` to the container args in `deploy/runtime-canary.yaml`.
chris: does this touch infra KMS key usage? anything that requires key rotation followup?
alex: no KMS changes. only reading existing model cache lease metadata. no writes. confirmation from runtime tests: `no-kms-change` in smoke logs.
sam: Security quick q: does routing decision change data plane headers? could leak tenant ids in logs?
alex: good call — routing adds no new headers. logs already have masked tenant ids. grep: `maskTenant = true`. I also added a unit test: `TestNoTenantLeak` in `orch/routing/policies_test.go`.
jen: deploy-bot: merge-check results — all CI green except perf-unit flake (transient). Canary window requested for Thu 09:00 UTC in PR description.
maya: I'll do a focused review tomorrow morning (UTC-8). if runtime approves I can sign off platform for canary.
chris: infra: fine from my side for canary. no infra changes.
sam: security: acked for canary with `observability` followup (need NG log sample after canary start). leaving an inline comment on PR about sample collection.
alex: thanks all. will queue canary for Thu 09:00 UTC. added a short runbook to the PR: steps, rollback command, signal metrics. :thumbsup:
maya: thx. alex — tag me when it's queued.
alex: will do. :rocket:
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: PR #49801 -> canary at 1719996000 (Thu 09:00 UTC).
